import sys
import math

def fft(re, im, inv):
    n = len(re)
    shiftVal = 32 - (n.bit_length() - 1)
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int('{:b}'.format(i << shiftVal)[::-1], 2)
        if i < j:
            re[i], re[j] = re[j], re[i]
            im[i], im[j] = im[j], im[i]
    length = 2
    while length <= n:
        half = length // 2
        wIdx = len(cs) // length
        for i in range(0, n, length):
            for j in range(half):
                k = j * wIdx
                wRe = csi[k] if inv else cs[k]
                wIm = sni[k] if inv else sn[k]
                uRe = re[i + j]
                uIm = im[i + j]
                vRe = re[i + j + half] * wRe - im[i + j + half] * wIm
                vIm = re[i + j + half] * wIm + im[i + j + half] * wRe
                re[i + j] = uRe + vRe
                im[i + j] = uIm + vIm
                re[i + j + half] = uRe - vRe
                im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm
        length <<= 1
    if inv:
        for i in range(n):
            re[i] /= n
            im[i] /= n

def multiplyMod(a, b, m):
    needLen = len(a) + len(b) - 1
    size = 1 << (needLen - 1).bit_length()
    aRe = [0.0] * size
    aIm = [0.0] * size
    for i in range(len(a)):
        x = a[i] % m
        aRe[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        aIm[i] = x >> 15
    fft(aRe, aIm, False)
    bRe = [0.0] * size
    bIm = [0.0] * size
    for i in range(len(b)):
        x = b[i] % m
        bRe[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        bIm[i] = x >> 15
    fft(bRe, bIm, False)
    aRe2 = [0.0] * size
    aIm2 = [0.0] * size
    bRe2 = [0.0] * size
    bIm2 = [0.0] * size
    for i in range(size):
        j = (size - i) & (size - 1)
        a1r = (aRe[i] + aRe[j]) / 2
        a1i = (aIm[i] - aIm[j]) / 2
        a2r = (aIm[i] + aIm[j]) / 2
        a2i = (aRe[j] - aRe[i]) / 2
        b1r = (bRe[i] + bRe[j]) / 2
        b1i = (bIm[i] - bIm[j]) / 2
        b2r = (bIm[i] + bIm[j]) / 2
        b2i = (bRe[j] - bRe[i]) / 2
        aRe2[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        aIm2[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        bRe2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        bIm2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
    fft(aRe2, aIm2, True)
    fft(bRe2, bIm2, True)
    resArr = [0] * needLen
    for i in range(needLen):
        aa = round(aRe2[i])
        bb = round(bRe2[i])
        cc = round(aIm2[i])
        resArr[i] = int((aa + (bb << 15) + (cc << 30)) % m)
    return resArr

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    totalN = int(input_data[0])
    totalK = int(input_data[1])
    v = [0] * 10
    index = 2
    for _ in range(totalK):
        v[int(input_data[index])] = 1
        index += 1
    ans = [1]
    p = totalN // 2
    global cs, sn, sni
    cs = [math.cos(2 * math.pi * i / 1024) for i in range(1024)]
    sn = [math.sin(2 * math.pi * i / 1024) for i in range(1024)]
    sni = [math.sin(-2 * math.pi * i / 1024) for i in range(1024)]
    while p > 0:
        if p & 1:
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, 998244353)
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, 998244353)
        p //= 2
    res = 0
    for x in ans:
        res = (res + x * x) % 998244353
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
